decisions.reason: Conferencing sits close to the firm's voice expertise, but it is a commoditising service under heavy competition from cloud collaboration tools, so it carries moderate risk; the firm's operational knowledge still lets it run the service for now.
The metro data centre network builds directly on the firm's owned fibre and data centre know-how, and it has a documented customer adoption the firm can learn from and expand.
Optical spectrum connectivity extends the firm's core fibre engineering knowledge toward high-bandwidth services and fits its strategic direction, as its dedicated web page shows.
The number ordering portal draws on the firm's software platform and regulatory know-how and supports real-time provisioning, so it fits well with existing capabilities.

Carrier pre-selection is a legacy, regulation-driven telephony product in a shrinking market, so the risk of withdrawal is substantial, but the firm's regulatory and voice expertise makes it cheap to keep serving existing customers for another year.
Direct voice network connection builds on the firm's established voice infrastructure and enterprise customer base, where it holds strong absorptive capacity.
